platform.note: Validation uses a shared AOSP platform; separate frontend checkouts and separate output directories. OrangeFox platform hooks are guarded with NOT_ORANGEFOX for TWRP.

device_configuration_source: Rewritten hardware configuration with blobs from official OS3.0.303.0.WNXCNXM; standalone v2 boot addresses and first-stage module layout reference map220v sheng

boot_layout_reference.used: v2 load addresses and /lib/modules first-stage loading approach; no reference kernel or module binaries copied

qti_bootcontrol.source: hardware/qcom-caf/bootctrl in the pinned source platform
qti_bootcontrol.used: QTI BootControl HAL source defaults, rebuilt for the recovery framework

gpt_ufs_support.used: gpt-utils source files with original licenses; local build module renamed libgptutils.sheng

twrp_avb_port.adaptation: Standalone stdio/exit-code glue in device tree; same AVB0 check, byte 123 set to 2, all four A/B targets, and native partial-failure aggregation. No backup or metadata operations.
